meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Reviewed AgentAnswerPresentationService against runtime-agent, observability and generated tool contracts. Fixed report families consume AgentTraceService safeTool evidence.report, preserve original observed values/history without retrieval, bound rows and keep complete accepted-answer fallback; executable tools and permissions are unchanged.

auth.review_note: Reviewed owner-only capability policy and unchanged authentication routes against the shared backend guidance. Browser claims cannot grant commerce_report; guest/customer denial and foreign-owner saved evidence denial are covered. Existing auth references remain accurate.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed product, stock, customer and coupon projections against existing StoreStats calculations. Documented line-count versus order-count, allocated refunds, within-period anonymous customer bands, missing customer keys and current status without quantities. Canonical commerce services and normal payment/order flows are unchanged.

content.review_note: Reviewed public ProductService and BlogService published selection and exclusion of future, draft, retired or private Markdown and paths.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed bounded A2UI API layout/slugs input and generated knowledge index against architecture, WebMCP, JSON-storage and deployment guidance. Canonical public selection and fixed catalogs remain the source; native saved evidence replays without new retrieval, and no storage, checkout, booking or deployment authority is added.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed the frontend skill addition against integration and settings guidance. It documents container-aware agent cards and native photo disclosures only; Google tag consent, configuration and reporting behavior remain the existing implementation.

http-errors.review_note: Reviewed shared backend guidance changes and existing request-failure references. Commerce report additions do not alter bootstrap or HTTP error handling; the newly fixed public discovery entry routes remain preserved.

interface.review_note: Cross-checked PHP presenters, renderer, native chat handlers and CSS against updated Design.md, frontend/admin UI skills and docs/a2ui.md. Product grid/list/detail/compare, grouped contacts, services and private report cards use container widths, 44px controls, native replay-safe photo disclosure and complete fallback. Public surfaces reject private report data/links.

mail.review_note: Reviewed AdminController changes limited to Enterprise capabilities and follow-up report context. No mail scheduling, transport, inbox or template behavior changes; existing email setup and backend references remain accurate.

mcp-clients.review_note: Cross-checked STDIO product selectors against PublicKnowledgeService schemas and shop/integrations guidance; owner grants and local credential transport remain unchanged.

media.review_note: Reviewed the admin UI skill addition against media deletion verification and architecture. Card images remain approved public raster paths, and disclosures change local visibility only; upload, deletion, ownership and stale-media safeguards are unchanged.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed the native presenter and updated admin UI guidance against the existing Enterprise help: report cards use only completed sanitized evidence, retain source/date/basis and editable task prompts, and do not change owner permissions or help access.

public-mcp.review_note: Cross-checked PublicMcpService exact-result presentation, PublicA2uiService layouts and public renderer with docs/public-mcp.md, docs/pages/shop.md and the updated docs/a2ui.md. Four read tools keep their transport/data scopes and safe links; selected products render real detail/comparison fields and the requested selection count.

sales-channels.review_note: Checked public product visibility, published navigation destinations and isolated first-party catalogue and policy discovery.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed updated UI skills, generated index and existing development/review workflow. This slice has focused PHP and real Chrome fixtures for the two native agents and public cards; exact-head CI and deployment acceptance remain required, with no dependency or release-policy change.
